# Farmsclub

> Private farmhouse rentals in the UAE. Three farms booked whole-property by the
> day or weekend: Grand Haven (Kalba, Sharjah), Happy Haven (Ras Al Khaimah) and
> Green Haven (Ras Al Khaimah). Every farm has a free 360deg virtual walkthrough.

## What Farmsclub is
Farmsclub rents entire private farmhouses — you get the gate code and the whole
property, not a room. Pools, lawns, barbecue yards, animal pens, shaded majlis
seating and parking. Suited to family weekends, birthdays, small weddings,
corporate offsites and staycations near Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah.

## Farms
- [Grand Haven, Kalba - Sharjah](https://www.farmsclub.ae/grand-haven.html): twelve acres between the Kalba mangroves and the Hajar foothills. Pool, large lawn, barbecue yard. 360deg tour: https://www.farmsclub.ae/grand-haven.html#tour
- [Happy Haven, Ras Al Khaimah](https://www.farmsclub.ae/happy-haven.html): eight acres an hour from Dubai, built around children, with animals. 360deg tour: https://www.farmsclub.ae/happy-haven.html#tour
- [Green Haven, Ras Al Khaimah](https://www.farmsclub.ae/green-haven.html): a mango and citrus orchard around a low white house — the quiet farm. 360deg tour: https://www.farmsclub.ae/green-haven.html#tour

## 360deg virtual tours
Each farm page carries a drag-to-look panorama viewer at the anchor #tour, with
spots for the pool, lawn, majlis, kitchen and orchard. Linking to
<farm-page>.html#tour opens the page directly at the walkthrough.

## FAQs
Each farm page has its own FAQ section at the anchor #faqs, answering that farm's
guest capacity, bedroom and bathroom count, pet policy, pool heating, check-in
times, parking and event rules. Club-wide booking questions are at https://www.farmsclub.ae/#faqs.
Pets are allowed at Happy Haven only. Capacities: Grand Haven sleeps 18 (60 day
guests, 8 bedrooms), Happy Haven sleeps 14 (40 day guests, 6 bedrooms), Green
Haven sleeps 10 (30 day guests, 4 bedrooms).

## Standards and arrival
Every room is cleaned before guests arrive and again after they leave, with fresh
linen each booking and the pool tested before each arrival. All three farms are run
by one management team. Each farm page has a "Before you come" section at the anchor
#arrival giving drive times from Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah, the road surface
and parking, how the gate code is sent, phone and Wi-Fi coverage, nearest supermarket,
pharmacy, hospital and fuel, and a season-by-season note (comfortable months, pool
heating window, fruit seasons). Enquiries are answered on WhatsApp 8am-11pm.

## Booking
Whole-farm bookings by day or weekend. Enquiries via the contact section of any
farm page.
